title: HangmanneR
text:
HangmanneR is hangman played with CRAN package names. You guess one letter at a time against a package sampled from a snapshot of CRAN metadata that ships with the package, 19,838 of them.
There is a hosted copy at https://matiasandina-hangmanner.share.connect.posit.cloud/, running on Posit Connect Cloud. You can also run it locally.

title: HangmanneR
text:
Run
library(HangmanneR)
run_app()
run_app() hands ... to shiny::shinyApp(), so the usual options still work:
run_app(options = list(port = 1234))

title: HangmanneR
text:
Playing
Type a letter and the guess registers on its own, or click Guess Letter. Digits and the dot count as guesses too, because package names use them. Six wrong guesses end the round, and the hearts under the controls are what is left.
Difficulty filters the pool by the length of the package name: Easy is 2 to 7 characters, Normal is 8 to 15, Hard is 16 and up. The Posit checkbox keeps only packages with Posit Software, PBC in the author field. Changing either setting deals a new package.
Hint shows the package description with the name blanked out. The description comes up on its own when the round ends, next to a link to the package on CRAN.

title: HangmanneR
text:
The data
The CSV holds the package name, the author field and the description for each package. It comes from TidyTuesday 2023 week 38, which in turn derives from the CRAN Collaboration Graph. It is a snapshot, so packages published since then will not show up.

title: Reference
text: Four functions are exported. Each one has a help page in the installed package, so ?run_app works too.

title: Reference
text:
run_app(...)
Starts the game. It registers inst/app/www as a Shiny resource path and then calls shiny::shinyApp(), passing ... straight through. Returns the app object, which starts the app when printed.

title: Reference
text:
app_ui()
Builds the interface: the Game, Settings and About tabs, plus the footer. It reads style.css and about_footer.html from the installed package through system.file(), so it works from any working directory.

title: Reference
text:
app_server(input, output, session)
Holds the game state and the rules. Guesses are lowercased before they are matched, and the match is fixed rather than a regular expression, so a dot guess means a literal dot.

title: Reference
text:
hangman_data()
Returns the CRAN snapshot as a data frame with Package, Author, Description and n_char, the last being the length of the package name that the difficulty setting filters on. The CSV is parsed the first time you call it and cached for the rest of the R session.
head(hangman_data()[, c("Package", "n_char")])

title: Reference
text:
Layout
R/                     app_ui, app_server, run_app, hangman_data
inst/app/www/          style.css, about_footer.html
inst/extdata/          pkgdata.csv
app.R                  loads the package and calls run_app(), for shinyapps.io
quarto/                source for this site, rendered into docs/
